content.title: About
content.content: The Double Cheeseburger is a classic fast‑food item consisting of two medium beef patties, two slices of cheese, a bun, lettuce, tomato, pickles, onion and sauce. It delivers a rich meat flavor, creamy cheese aroma and a crunchy vegetable texture.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The Double Cheeseburger entered major fast‑food menus in the early 1990s.
Each medium patty weighs about 80 g, totaling roughly 160 g of meat.
Two slices of processed cheese add up to about 150 mg of calcium per serving.
The burger is often served with fries and a soft drink as a combo meal.
Some regions offer variations with bacon or barbecue sauce.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: The beef patties provide approximately 20 g of protein, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: Red meat contains heme iron, which is more readily absorbed by the body.

items.title: Calcium from cheese
items.content: Cheese contributes calcium essential for bone and teeth health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Meat and cheese supply B12, B6 and niacin, aiding energy metabolism.

items.title: Energy dense
items.content: The burger provides roughly 500–600 kcal, quickly replenishing energy stores.

items.title: High calorie and fat content
items.content: The large amount of saturated fat and calories can contribute to weight gain if consumed frequently.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Sauces and cheese can add significant salt, which may be problematic for people with hypertension.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Cheese may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy.

items.title: Meat quality concerns
items.content: High‑temperature cooking can produce potentially harmful compounds such as acrylamide.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The burger is typically eaten by hand, holding the bottom bun. It can be customized with extra sauce, added bacon, or a whole‑grain bun for a healthier twist.

content.title: Storage
content.content: A prepared Double Cheeseburger should be refrigerated and consumed within 24 hours. For longer storage, freeze it and reheat in an oven or microwave before serving.
